units.title: 医药章总纲：占医药以子孙为用，临日月为上、旺相次之、休囚为下、空破散绝为庸医；章内六问——占药、占医、治病、用药、往医、行道

rule.yi: 占医药的总纲：拿子孙爻当用。子孙临日、月是上等，旺相是次等，休囚是下等，空、破、散、绝就是庸医。这一章开头先说了几句话：得志的时候愿意做良相，不得志的时候愿意做良医；君子借医来施展志向，做儿子的要懂得医理，吉凶取舍能不慎重吗？章里分六问细讲：占药、占医、治病、用药、往医、行道；头两问是病家问，后四问（治病、用药、往医、行道）都是医生自己问。
rule.en: The outline for divining medicine and doctors: take Output as the one to use. Output sitting on the Day or Month is best, thriving and strong is next, resting and trapped is lowest, and Void, broken, scattered or in Extinction is a mediocre doctor. The chapter opens with a few remarks: when successful one wishes to be a good minister, when not, a good doctor; the gentleman carries out his will through medicine, and a son must know medicine, so how can one not be careful in choosing between fortune and misfortune? The chapter then treats six questions in detail: divining the medicine, divining the doctor, treating the illness, using the medicine, going to treat, and the doctor's practice; the first two are asked by the patient's family and the last four (treating, using, going, practising) are all asked by the doctor himself.

zh: 闻之称贤曰：达则愿为良相，不达则愿为良医。
君子以之行志，人子教其须知，吉凶从违，可不慎与？
yi: 听到被称为贤人的人说过：得志的时候愿意做良相，不得志的时候愿意做良医。
君子借医来施展自己的志向，做儿子的要学会该知道的医理，吉凶的取舍，能不慎重吗？
en: I have heard one called a worthy say: if I succeed, I wish to be a good minister; if I do not, a good doctor.
The gentleman puts his will into practice through it, and a son is taught that he must know it; in following or avoiding fortune and misfortune, can one not be careful?

zh: 凡占医药，以子孙为用，临日月为上，旺相次之，休囚为下，空破散绝为庸医也。
yi: 凡是占医药，以子孙爻当用，子孙临日、月是上等，旺相是次等，休囚是下等，空、破、散、绝就是庸医。
en: In all divining of medicine and doctors, Output is the line to use: sitting on the Day or Month is best, thriving and strong is next, resting and trapped is lowest, and Void, broken, scattered or in Extinction is a mediocre doctor.

zh: 内详占药、占医、治病、用药、往医、行道六问
yi: 里面详细讲六个问题：占药、占医、治病、用药、往医、行道。
en: The chapter treats in detail six questions: divining the medicine, divining the doctor, treating the illness, using the medicine, going to treat, and the doctor's practice.

note.yi: 「用」在这里指取用，和「用神」是一回事：占医药不取病人的用神，取子孙爻。黄金策的医药章同样以子孙为药饵、应爻为医人（见 LY.ILL.HJC.58），下面第二条（LY.ILL.YM.36）也说应爻指医人。目录注里的「往医」「行道」是医生的问法（见后面 LY.ILL.YM.40、YM.41）：「往医」是医生上门去治，「行道」是医生行医的前程。这一条把原文里的目录注放在了最后。
note.en: 'Use' here means the one to take, the same thing as the Subject: in divining medicine one does not take the patient's Subject but the Output line. The Huangjin Ce's chapter on medicine likewise takes Output as the medicine and the Other as the doctor (see LY.ILL.HJC.58), and the second entry below (LY.ILL.YM.36) also says the Other stands for the doctor. 'Going to treat' and 'practising' in the contents note are the doctor's own questions (see LY.ILL.YM.40 and YM.41 below): 'going to treat' is the doctor visiting a patient, and 'practising' is the course of the doctor's practice. In this entry the contents note from the original is placed last.

units.title: 子官强弱定药效：无子药不良、强官病不治；子强官弱如烈日销冰、子弱官强如铅刀攻玉；财动鬼静子动无功；伏鬼根不除、化鬼病传变、空鬼药老；世鬼病曲折、应鬼药跷蹊

rule.yi: 卦里没有子孙，药就不好；官鬼强，病就治不好。子孙强、官鬼弱，像烈日融冰；子孙弱、官鬼强，像用铅刀去攻玉。财爻动、鬼爻静，子孙动，都没有功效。鬼伏着，病根拔不掉；变出鬼，病会传变；鬼落空，药就是「老」药。鬼临世爻而兴旺，我的病就曲折反复；鬼临应爻而旺相，那副药就古怪蹊跷。注说：要审察子孙和官鬼的强弱，鬼当值日、月时，即使子孙得到生扶也不算完全好，要比较子孙能不能制住鬼，才是吉占；鬼落空是躲开了子孙，药打不中病，所以叫「老」；鬼在世，病难很快好，鬼在应，医生诡诈难信。
rule.en: Without Output the medicine is not good, and with a strong Pressure line the illness cannot be cured. Output strong and Pressure weak is a fierce sun melting ice; Output weak and Pressure strong is a lead knife attacking jade. With Wealth moving and the ghost still, or Output moving, there is no effect. A hidden ghost means the root is not removed; a change into a ghost means the illness passes on and changes; a Void ghost makes the medicine 'aged'. A ghost thriving on the Self makes my illness twist and turn, and a ghost strong on the Other makes that medicine dubious. The note says: one must examine the strength of Output and Pressure; when the ghost is on duty in the Day or Month, even if Output meets generation and support it is not wholly good, and one must compare whether Output can subdue the ghost before it is an auspicious divination; a Void ghost evades Output and so the medicine does not hit the illness, hence 'aged'; a ghost on the Self means the illness is hard to cure quickly, and a ghost on the Other means the doctor is deceitful and hard to trust.

zh: 无子而药不良，强官而病不治；
子强官弱，烈日销冰，子弱官强，铅刀攻玉，财动鬼静，子动无功也。
伏鬼根不除，化鬼病传（转？）变，空鬼老医药。
世鬼兴隆，则吾病曲折，应鬼旺相，则彼药跷蹊。
yi: 卦里没有子孙，药就不好；官鬼强，病就治不好；
子孙强、官鬼弱，像烈日融冰；子孙弱、官鬼强，像用铅刀去攻玉；财爻动、鬼爻静，子孙动，都没有功效。
鬼伏着，病根拔不掉；变出鬼，病会传变（「传」字后面转录者标了「转？」）；鬼落空，药就是「老」药。
鬼临世爻而兴旺，我的病就曲折反复；鬼临应爻而旺相，那副药就古怪蹊跷。
en: Without Output the medicine is not good, and with a strong Pressure line the illness cannot be cured;

Output strong and Pressure weak is a fierce sun melting ice; Output weak and Pressure strong is a lead knife attacking jade; with Wealth moving and the ghost still, or Output moving, there is no effect.

A hidden ghost means the root is not removed; a change into a ghost means the illness passes on and changes (the transcription marks 'transforms?' after 'passes on'); a Void ghost makes the medicine 'aged'.
A ghost thriving on the Self makes my illness twist and turn; a ghost strong on the Other makes that medicine queer and dubious.

zh: 当审子官强弱，如鬼值日月，虽子遇生扶，亦未尽善，必较子可服鬼，方是吉占。
鬼空避子，药不中病，故云老也。
世鬼病难速愈，应鬼医诈难信。
yi: 应当审察子孙和官鬼的强弱：如果鬼当值日、月，即使子孙得到生扶，也不算完全好，一定要比较子孙能不能制住鬼，才是吉占。
鬼落空是躲开了子孙，药打不中病，所以说「老」。
鬼在世爻，病很难快好；鬼在应爻，医生诡诈，难以相信。
en: One must examine the strength of Output and Pressure: if the ghost is on duty in the Day or Month, even though Output meets generation and support it is not wholly good; one must compare whether Output can subdue the ghost, and only then is it an auspicious divination.
A Void ghost evades Output, so the medicine does not hit the illness, hence it is called 'aged'.
A ghost on the Self, the illness is hard to cure quickly; a ghost on the Other, the doctor is deceitful and hard to trust.

note.yi: 经文里的「老医药」，注说是「鬼空避子，药不中病，故云老也」：「老」是指药不对症，像一味放老了的药。「财动鬼静，子动无功」这一句原文不带说明，注也没解；字面是财爻动、鬼爻静、子孙动的时候没有功效，和上一句「子强官弱」并不矛盾——财动是在生鬼（或冲克父母），子孙即使动，制鬼的力气也被财爻的生助抵掉了，这是推的，书里没有写。「传（转？）变」的「转？」是转录者自己标的疑字，这里照录，没有改。这一条与黄金策医药章「官旺福衰药饵轻而病重」（LY.ILL.HJC.61）、「福化忌爻误服杀身之恶剂」（HJC.66）是同一路读法。
note.en: For the text's 'aged medicine', the note says a Void ghost evades Output and the medicine does not hit the illness, hence it is called aged: 'aged' means the medicine does not fit the illness, like a herb left to go stale. The sentence 'Wealth moving, the ghost still, Output moving: no effect' comes without comment in the text and the note does not explain it; literally it says there is no effect when Wealth moves, the ghost is still and Output moves, and this does not conflict with 'Output strong and Pressure weak' just before, since Wealth moving feeds the ghost (or clashes the Resource line) and even a moving Output has its strength against the ghost cancelled by the Wealth's support, but this is inferred and not written in the book. The 'transforms?' after 'passes on' is the transcriber's own mark of doubt and is copied as it stands. This entry reads in the same way as the Huangjin Ce's medicine chapter, 'Pressure strong and Output weak, the medicine light and the illness heavy' (LY.ILL.HJC.61) and 'Output changing into an Adversary line, a bad draught that kills' (HJC.66).

units.title: 应指医人、非占克效：应空不得遇、应破不得专、应散识见反惑、应克世好利多诈、世应冲绝续不终

rule.yi: 应爻指的是医生，不是拿来占能不能克住病的：所以应落空，遇不上这个医生；应被冲破，医生不专心；应散，医生的见识反倒糊涂；应克世，医生爱财、多诈；世应相冲，治疗断断续续，做不到底。
rule.en: The Other stands for the doctor, and is not for divining whether the illness will be overcome: so with the Other Void, one cannot meet this doctor; broken, the doctor is not devoted; scattered, his insight is confused instead; the Other controlling the Self, the doctor loves profit and is full of deceit; Self and Other clashing, the treatment breaks off and is not carried to the end.

zh: 夫应指医人，非占克效，是故应空不得遇，应破不得专，应散则识见反惑，应克世则好利多诈，世应冲则绝续不终也。
yi: 应爻指的是医生，不是拿来占克住病的效验的，所以应落空，遇不上；应被冲破，医生不专心；应散，识见反倒糊涂；应克世，爱财、多诈；世应相冲，治疗断断续续，做不到底。
en: The Other stands for the doctor, and is not for divining the efficacy of overcoming the illness; therefore, with the Other Void, one cannot meet him; broken, he cannot be devoted; scattered, his insight is instead confused; the Other controlling the Self, he loves profit and is full of deceit; Self and Other clashing, the treatment breaks off and does not last to the end.

note.yi: 这一条把医生和药分开：药看子孙（LY.ILL.YM.34、YM.35），医生看应爻；问药灵不灵不取应，问医生可不可信不取子孙。黄金策同样以应爻为医人（LY.ILL.HJC.58、HJC.62），增删卜易也以应爻为医人，应爻不宜空破墓绝（LY.ILL.ZS.29）。「绝续不终」的「绝续」指治疗断了又续，始终不能了结。
note.en: This entry separates the doctor from the medicine: the medicine is read from Output (LY.ILL.YM.34, YM.35) and the doctor from the Other line; to ask whether a medicine works one does not take the Other, and to ask whether the doctor can be trusted one does not take Output. The Huangjin Ce likewise takes the Other as the doctor (LY.ILL.HJC.58, HJC.62), and the Zengshan Buyi also takes the Other as the doctor, who should not be Void, broken, in a tomb or in Extinction (LY.ILL.ZS.29). 'Breaks off and does not last to the end' means the treatment stops and resumes but is never concluded.

units.title: 占药占医取象：水子旺宜汤、土子旺宜丸、火灸金针木末；火鬼喜凉药、木鬼喜风药、土脾金肺水肾；占医考子孙之属，木东金西乾僧坤妇——注：子为药鬼为病，象只用来问何药何人，问吉凶仍看子孙衰旺

rule.yi: 占药：水属的子孙旺，宜用汤剂；土属的子孙旺，宜用丸药；火像艾灸，金像针，木像药末，以这些作象。火鬼喜欢凉药，木鬼喜欢祛风的药；土对应脾，金对应肺，水对应肾，也以这些作象。占医生：要考察子孙属于哪一类，木属东、金属西，乾是僧人、坤是妇人，也以这些作象。注说：子孙是药，鬼是病，占该用什么药、是什么病，就用这个办法；如果占的是这味药吉不吉，就看子孙的衰旺，不要死板地认为子孙属土就该用丸药。占该请哪个方位、哪种人当医生，也是这个办法；单独占医生好不好，还是用子孙的强弱，比如问请僧人当医生，得乾卦而子孙落空，怎么能说吉？
rule.en: Divining medicine: a strong Water Output suits a decoction, a strong Earth Output suits pills; Fire is moxibustion, Metal needles, Wood powders, taken as the images. A Fire ghost likes cooling medicine and a Wood ghost likes wind medicine; Earth is the spleen, Metal the lung and Water the kidney, also taken as images. Divining the doctor: examine what kind the Output belongs to; Wood is east and Metal west, Qian a monk and Kun a woman, again taken as images. The note says: Output is the medicine and the ghost is the illness, and to divine which medicine to use or what the illness is, use this method; but if what is divined is whether a medicine is auspicious, use the strength of Output, and do not rigidly hold that an Earth Output must mean pills. To divine which direction and which kind of person to use as doctor the method is the same; but to divine on its own whether the doctor is good, still use the strength of Output: for instance, if one asks about a monk-doctor and obtains Qian with Output Void, how could one call it auspicious?

zh: 占药水子旺宜汤，土子旺宜丸，火灸、金针、木末、以为像。
火鬼喜凉药，木鬼喜风药，土脾、金肺、水肾，以为像。
占医也，考子孙之属，木东金西，乾僧坤妇，以为像。
yi: 占药：水属的子孙旺，宜用汤剂；土属的子孙旺，宜用丸药；火像艾灸，金像针，木像药末，以这些作象。
火鬼喜欢凉药，木鬼喜欢祛风的药；土对应脾，金对应肺，水对应肾，也以这些作象。
占医生，要考察子孙属于哪一类：木属东、金属西，乾是僧人、坤是妇人，以此作象。
en: In divining medicine: a strong Water Output suits a decoction, a strong Earth Output suits pills; Fire is moxibustion, Metal needles, Wood powders: these are the images.
A Fire ghost likes cooling medicine and a Wood ghost likes wind medicine; Earth is the spleen, Metal the lung and Water the kidney: these are the images.
In divining the doctor, examine what the Output belongs to: Wood is east and Metal west, Qian a monk and Kun a woman: these are the images.

zh: 子为药而鬼为病，卜用何药，卜是何病，则用此法，若卜是药吉凶，用子孙衰旺，无执子孙属土，宜用丸药。
如卯建辛酉日，占医得离之贲，未土子爻，真空四败，焉能丸药有功？
卜筮宜用何方何人，则用此法，若独占则用子孙，设问僧医，得乾而子空，岂可言吉？
yi: 子孙是药，鬼是病。占该用什么药、占是什么病，就用这个办法；如果占的是这味药吉不吉，就看子孙的衰旺，不要死板地认为子孙属土就该用丸药。
比如卯月辛酉日，占医生，得离卦变贲卦，未土子爻，是真空，又逢四败，怎么能说丸药有功效？
占该请哪个方位、哪种人当医生，就用这个办法；如果单独占医生好不好，就用子孙，假如问请僧人当医生，得乾卦而子孙落空，怎么能说吉？
en: Output is the medicine and the ghost is the illness. To divine which medicine to use, or what illness it is, use this method; but if what is divined is whether a medicine is auspicious, use the strength of Output, and do not rigidly hold that an Earth Output must mean pills.

For example, in a Mao month on a Xinyou day, a doctor was divined and Li changing into Bi (Adornment) was obtained; the Wei Earth Output was truly Void and met the four Defeats; how could pills be effective?

To divine which direction or which kind of person to use, apply this method; but if it is divined on its own, use Output: suppose one asks about a monk-doctor and obtains Qian with Output Void, how could one call it auspicious?

dispute.yi: 用药要不要按五行来配：易冒把「水子旺宜汤、土子旺宜丸、火灸金针木末」「火鬼喜凉药、木鬼喜风药」当作象，但注马上限定，象只用来问「用何药、是何病」，问吉凶还是看子孙衰旺，不要认死「子孙属土就用丸药」；黄金策旧注、王洪绪和易隐把五行当作用药的依据（火鬼旺用大寒药、水鬼旺用大热药、金鬼宜灸、木鬼宜针，见 LY.ILL.HJC.76、HJC.81、HJC.84、YY.25）；增删卜易的李我平则批评这类说法拘泥，说子孙不是针灸之药、火鬼旺不一定该用大寒药（LY.ILL.ZS.40）。易冒站在中间：象可以用，但不作凭据。
dispute.en: Whether medicine should be matched by the phases: the Yi Mao takes 'a strong Water Output suits a decoction, an Earth Output pills, Fire moxibustion, Metal needles, Wood powders' and 'a Fire ghost likes cooling medicine, a Wood ghost wind medicine' as images, but the note at once limits them: images are used only for 'which medicine to use and what the illness is', while for whether it is auspicious one still reads the strength of Output and should not hold rigidly that 'an Earth Output means pills'; the old commentary and Wang Hongxu on the Huangjin Ce and the Yi Yin take the phases as the ground for the choice of medicine (a strong Fire ghost takes a very cold medicine, a strong Water ghost a very hot one, a Metal ghost moxibustion, a Wood ghost needles; see LY.ILL.HJC.76, HJC.81, HJC.84, YY.25); Li Woping of the Zengshan Buyi criticises such sayings as rigid, saying Output is not a medicine for needles and moxibustion and that a strong Fire ghost does not necessarily call for a very cold medicine (LY.ILL.ZS.40). The Yi Mao stands in the middle: the images may be used, but not as the ground.

note.yi: 「四败」是十二长生里的沐浴：金败在午、木败在子、火败在卯、水土败在酉（见卜筮大全，沐浴即四败）；例中辛酉日，土的败正在酉，所以说逢四败。「真空」在易冒旬空章里指被月建克住的那种空（春天的土、夏天的金、秋天的木、冬天的火，以及辰戌丑未月里的水），卯月里的未土正是春土，所以叫真空。「以为像」的「像」就是象。
note.en: 'The four Defeats' is Bath in the twelve life stages: Metal's Defeat is at Wu, Wood's at Zi, Fire's at Mao, and Water's and Earth's at You (see the Bushi Daquan, where Bath is the four Defeats); in the case the day is Xinyou, and Earth's Defeat is exactly at You, hence 'meets the four Defeats'. 'True Void' in the Yi Mao's chapter on Void means the Void of a line controlled by the Month (Earth in spring, Metal in summer, Wood in autumn, Fire in winter, and Water in the Chen, Xu, Chou and Wei months), and the Wei Earth in a Mao month is spring Earth, hence 'truly Void'. The 'xiang' in 'taken as images' is the image.

units.title: 医问疾可疗乎：以应为先务（应为病人），应坏、随墓则其病不治；若占六亲仍以用神为断

rule.yi: 医生问这个病能不能治，先看应爻，因为对医生来说应爻就是病人；应爻坏了、或随墓，这个病就治不好。如果占的是病人的某个亲属，仍然以用神来断。
rule.en: When a doctor asks whether an illness can be treated, the Other line comes first, for to him the Other is the patient; if the Other is spoiled or follows into the tomb, the illness cannot be cured. If what is divined is one of the patient's relations, judgment still goes by the Subject.

zh: 医问疾可疗乎，以应为先务，盖应为病人，应坏随墓，其病不治；
若占六亲，仍以用神为断。
yi: 医生问这个病能不能治，先看应爻，因为对医生来说应爻就是病人，应爻坏了、随墓，这个病就治不好；
如果占的是病人的某个亲属，仍然以用神来断。
en: When a doctor asks whether an illness can be treated, the Other comes first, for to him the Other is the patient; if the Other is spoiled or follows into the tomb, the illness cannot be cured;
if what is divined is one of the patient's relations, judgment still goes by the Subject.

note.yi: 医生自己占的时候，对方（应）就是病人，所以头一个要看的是应爻；这和病家占病取世（自己）或取用神不同。「若占六亲」是说医生受托问的其实是病人的某个亲属，这时不再取应，回到用神。这是治病问的。
note.en: When the doctor himself divines, the other party (the Other) is the patient, so the first thing to read is the Other line; this differs from the patient's family, who take the Self (oneself) or the Subject. 'If what is divined is a relation' means the doctor is in fact asked about one of the patient's relations, and then the Other is no longer taken and judgment returns to the Subject. This entry answers the question of treating the illness.

units.title: 医问是药奏功乎：亦以子孙为用，福强鬼弱而奏效、子虚鬼实而无功（与占药同）

rule.yi: 医生问这味药能不能奏效，也是拿子孙爻当用：子孙强、鬼弱，药就见效；子孙虚、鬼实，药就没有功效。注说：和占药一样。
rule.en: When a doctor asks whether a medicine will take effect, Output is again the line to use: with Output strong and the ghost weak it takes effect, and with Output empty and the ghost full it has no effect. The note says: it is the same as divining medicine.

zh: 医问是药奏功乎，亦以子孙为用，福强鬼弱而奏效也，子虚鬼实而无功。
yi: 医生问这味药能不能奏效，也是以子孙为用：子孙强、鬼弱，药就见效；子孙虚、鬼实，药就没有功效。
en: When a doctor asks whether a medicine will take effect, Output is again the line to use: with Output strong and the ghost weak it takes effect, and with Output empty and the ghost full it has no effect.

zh: 亦如占药。
yi: 也和占药一样。
en: It is the same as divining medicine.

note.yi: 这一条是用药问：医生已经开了某味药，问它灵不灵，取子孙的强弱，和病家占药一样（见 LY.ILL.YM.35、YM.37）。「福强鬼弱」的「福」是子孙，「子虚鬼实」的「虚」「实」用的是上面 LY.ILL.YM.31 里的意思：空破散绝叫虚，旺相有生扶叫实。
note.en: This entry is the question of using the medicine: the doctor has settled on a certain medicine and asks whether it will work, and takes the strength of Output, as the patient's family does in divining medicine (see LY.ILL.YM.35, YM.37). The 'fortune' in 'fortune strong, ghost weak' is Output, and 'empty' and 'full' in 'Output empty, ghost full' are used in the sense given in LY.ILL.YM.31 above: Void, broken, scattered or in Extinction is empty, and thriving and strong with generation and support is full.

units.title: 医问往医利乎：以世应推——应克世者寡情、爻无财者薄赠、空有欺志、破无专心、散冲无终

rule.yi: 医生问上门去治病有没有利，就从世、应来推：应克世的，病家没有情义；卦里没有财爻的，酬谢微薄；落空的，有欺骗的心思；冲破的，没有专心；散了、冲了的，不会有个结果。
rule.en: When a doctor asks whether going to treat will be profitable, judge by the Self and the Other: the Other controlling the Self means little feeling; a hexagram with no Wealth line means a meagre gift; Void means an intent to deceive; broken, no wholehearted devotion; scattered or clashed, no end.

zh: 医问往医利乎，则以世应而推，应克世者寡情，爻无财者薄赠，空有欺志，破无专心，散、冲无终。
yi: 医生问上门去治病有没有利，就从世、应来推：应克世的，病家没有情义；卦里没有财爻的，酬谢微薄；落空的，有欺骗的心思；冲破的，没有专心；散了、冲了的，不会有个结果。
en: When a doctor asks whether going to treat will be profitable, judge by the Self and the Other: the Other controlling the Self means little feeling; a hexagram with no Wealth line means a meagre gift; Void means an intent to deceive; broken, no wholehearted devotion; scattered or clashed, no end.

note.yi: 原文里「空有欺志，破无专心，散、冲无终」没有说是谁的空、破、散、冲；按上文「以世应而推」，这里译作世、应落空、冲破、散、冲时的情形，没有替它加主语。这是医生问的第三种（往医）。
note.en: The original does not say whose Void, breaking, scattering or clash it is in 'Void has intent to deceive, broken has no devotion, scattered or clashed has no end'; following 'judge by the Self and the Other' just before, it is rendered as the case when the Self and Other are Void, broken, scattered or clashed, and no subject has been added. This is the third of the doctor's questions (going to treat).

units.title: 医问道行：财官强而利名遂；医药不精不足以利物、求医不慎不足以疗生，己弗误人亦弗自误

rule.yi: 医生问自己行医的前程：财爻、官爻强，名和利就能遂愿。所以医术不精，不足以造福万物；求医不谨慎，不足以救人性命；自己不耽误别人，也不耽误自己。
rule.en: When a doctor asks about the course of his practice, if the Wealth and Pressure lines are strong, profit and fame are achieved. So medicine that is not refined cannot benefit things, and seeking a doctor without care cannot heal life; if one does not mislead others, one does not mislead oneself.

zh: 医问道行，财官强而利名遂，故医药不精，不足以利物，求医不慎，不足以疗生，己弗误人，亦弗自误也。
yi: 医生问行医的前程，财爻、官爻强，名和利就能遂愿；所以医术不精，不足以造福万物，求医不谨慎，不足以救人性命，自己不耽误别人，也不耽误自己。
en: When a doctor asks about the course of his practice, if the Wealth and Pressure lines are strong, profit and fame are achieved; therefore, medicine that is not refined cannot benefit things, and seeking a doctor without care cannot heal life; if one does not mislead others, one does not mislead oneself.

note.yi: 「财官强而利名遂」是本条唯一的断法：财主利，官主名。后半句「故医药不精……」是章末的劝诫，对医生也对病家说：医生的技术不精，不能救人；病家选医生不小心，也救不了命。「财官」这里是财爻和官爻，原文没有写「妻财」「官鬼」，但意思相同。
note.en: 'Wealth and Pressure strong, profit and fame are achieved' is the only judgment in this entry: Wealth governs profit and Pressure governs fame. The second half, 'so medicine that is not refined...', is the chapter's closing admonition, addressed to the doctor and to the patient's family alike: a doctor whose skill is poor cannot save a life, and a family that chooses a doctor carelessly cannot save it either. 'Wealth and Pressure' here are the Wealth line and the Pressure line, written without 'wife-wealth' or 'official-ghost' but meaning the same.
